folders.name: 00 Health and keys
folders.description: Is the server up? Run these first on every target.

folders.name: 01 Staff sign-in and MFA
folders.description: Sign in with email + password, then a second step. First sign-in: email code, change the one-time password, enrol YOUR OWN authenticator app, then sign in again with the app.

folders.name: 02 Users and admin settings
folders.description: Staff accounts, availability, settings, kill switch, company details, message texts.

folders.name: 03 Contacts, companies and deals
folders.description: The CRM records a buyer conversation creates. Run 'List deals' after each buyer test.

folders.name: 04 Products, stock and price list
folders.description: Catalogue, price tiers (list price + minimum per quantity), stock, FX rates.

folders.name: 05 Quotes, approvals and change requests
folders.description: The backend builds every quote; staff approve it before it is sent.

folders.name: 06 Payment, won and orders
folders.description: After the final quote: payment, WON, order tracking.

folders.name: 07 Dashboards and exports
folders.description: Dashboards per role and CSV / XLSX exports.

folders.name: 08 Channels admin
folders.description: Company WhatsApp numbers / mailboxes and message templates.

folders.name: 09 Buyer simulation - WhatsApp
folders.description: Pretend to be a buyer on WhatsApp. The request is signed automatically from wa_app_secret.

folders.name: 10 Buyer simulation - Website chat
folders.description: Pretend to be a website visitor (public API, no staff login).

folders.name: 11 CMS publish webhook
folders.description: Pretend to be the website CMS publishing a product. Signed automatically.

folders.name: 12 Unsubscribe link
folders.description: The one-click unsubscribe link printed in every buyer email.

folders.name: 13 Telnyx call webhooks
folders.description: Call-status callbacks from the phone provider. Signed automatically (URL token).

folders.name: 14 Negative and security tests
folders.description: Requests that MUST be refused. A pass here means the server said no.

folders.name: 15 CMS: website content and editors
folders.description: D54: the website's content reads (public, cached) and the editors' draft / publish / versions / media API (content editor, admin, manager). Sign in first (folder 01).

routes.name: 12. Forgot password - set new password

routes.name: List staff users (saves user_id / sales_user_id)
routes.purpose: §20.11 users and roles: every staff member with MFA enrolment and lock state.

routes.name: Create a staff user (MFA)

routes.purpose: Admin (MFA): a new staff user; the one-time password in the answer is shown once.

routes.name: Edit a staff user (MFA)
routes.who: md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Admin (MFA): role, active flag, phone, languages / countries / categories for assignment (§9), alert channels.

routes.name: Reset a user's authenticator (lost phone, MFA)
routes.who: md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: A lost authenticator: sessions end; the person signs in with an email code and enrols again.

routes.name: Unlock a locked-out user (MFA)
routes.who: md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Admin (MFA): lift a lock-out after too many wrong passwords or codes.

routes.name: List deals (newest first; saves deal_id)
routes.purpose: §20.3 deals board: by stage, with filters for salesperson, country, product and value (the current quote's total in AED).

routes.name: Get deal (saves deal_version, contact_id)
routes.purpose: §20.4 deal page: buyer, company, requirement, stage, AI state, AI summary (§7A.2), opt-out.

routes.name: Deal timeline (messages, AI replies, stage changes)
routes.purpose: §20.4 full timeline: every message, call transcript, stage change and AI action (newest first).

routes.name: Quote versions of the deal (saves version_id)
routes.purpose: §20.4 quote versions, newest first (the screen compares two side by side).

routes.name: Draft a quote (the backend prices it)
routes.purpose: Ask the backend to build the quote from the price list (§11.1).

routes.name: Move deal stage (example: LOST)
routes.purpose: Move the deal to another stage (rules in §5; LOST needs a reason).

routes.name: Revise the quote (prices, quantity, currency)
routes.purpose: §11.3 Edit then approve: a new version; below the minimum goes to the manager first (D3).

routes.name: Switch the AI on / off for a deal
routes.purpose: Manager/MD takes over (AI off) or hands the conversation back (AI on).

routes.name: Manager makes a price offer (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: §12 below-minimum alert, manager (MFA): set an approved special price (may be below the range, D3); it becomes a price the AI may state, and `resume_ai` hands the chat back to the AI.

routes.name: Reopen a closed deal (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: §7A.1 / D24: the manager (or MD) reopens a LOST deal to the stage it was lost from; the AI stays paused until a person resumes it.

routes.name: Record: salesperson shared a personal contact
routes.purpose: §14 practical notes: record that the salesperson shared a personal contact with the buyer.

routes.name: Staff sends a message to the buyer
routes.purpose: §14 / D21: reply to the buyer on the same channel and company number, signed with the salesperson's name.

routes.name: Click-to-call the buyer (saves attempt_id)
routes.purpose: §14: click-to-call through the company number.

routes.name: Record a buyer opt-out by hand
routes.purpose: §8.1 step 4: the salesperson records a stop (and the buyer's own reason, if given) after a conversation the buyer started.

routes.name: Record a payment (MFA)
routes.who: sales, manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: §15.1 / D20: the salesperson (human, MFA) confirms the advance; every detail is optional.

routes.name: Mark the deal WON (MFA)
routes.who: sales, manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: §15.2: WON (mandatory) with an optional expected re-order date; the order record is created.

routes.name: Update order status
routes.purpose: §15.3 order tracking: in production -> ready -> shipped -> delivered (the buyer is told if configured).

routes.name: Reassign the deal to a salesperson
routes.purpose: §9.4: the manager or MD reassigns; both salespersons are notified, pending items follow.

routes.name: MD takes over the deal
routes.purpose: §3: the MD takes the deal over; the salesperson is read-only until hand-back.

routes.name: MD hands the deal back
routes.purpose: End an MD or manager takeover: the salesperson can edit and approve again (§3).

routes.name: Hand-priced quote (custom / unpriced item)
routes.purpose: D8 / §23 scenario 5: a quote priced by hand by the salesperson, then approved as usual.

routes.name: Get one quote version
routes.purpose: §11.3 quote approval screen: one quote version with its lines, terms, delivery and totals.

routes.name: Cost view of a quote version (MD only)
routes.purpose: Cost build-up of each line: MD only (T3).

routes.name: Open approvals (manager / MD; saves approval_id)
routes.purpose: Manager / MD: approvals open (with SLA deadlines, §16) or decided.

routes.name: Approve / reject a quote or special price (MFA)
routes.who: sales, manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Human + MFA only.

routes.name: List change requests (saves cr_id)
routes.purpose: Open cards with SLA timers, oldest due first.

routes.name: Get a change request
routes.purpose: §13 change request card: what the buyer asked (their words), current vs requested values, SLA.

routes.name: Start work on a change request
routes.purpose: Take the change request (starts work; the SLA keeps running).

routes.name: Revise the quote for a change request
routes.purpose: "Revise quote": a new version with the edits; approving it resolves the card (§13.3-4).

routes.name: Resolve a change request with a version
routes.purpose: Close the change request as done (a revised quote was sent or the answer given).

routes.name: Decline a change request
routes.purpose: Decline the change request with a reason the buyer is told.

routes.name: My inbox (approvals, change requests, tasks; saves approval_id / cr_id)
routes.purpose: §20.2: approvals, change requests, below-minimum alerts, buyer messages on handed-over deals.

routes.name: Price tiers of a product (saves tier_id)
routes.purpose: §20.7 price list: the quantity tiers of one product (list price and minimum per tier).

routes.name: Add a price tier (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Manager (MFA): add a quantity tier (every change is logged, §3).

routes.name: Edit a price tier (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Manager (MFA): change a tier's prices or quantities (logged with old and new value).

routes.name: Delete a price tier (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Manager (MFA): delete a tier (logged).

routes.name: Import the price list .xlsx (MFA)

routes.name: Export the price list .xlsx

routes.name: Price history of a product

routes.name: Price list change log
routes.purpose: §20.7 change history of the whole price list (tier edits and Excel imports), newest first.

routes.name: Stock table
routes.purpose: §20.8 stock table: quantity on hand per product or material.

routes.name: Update stock
routes.purpose: Manager or admin: set the quantity on hand of a product or material (logged).

routes.name: Download the product workbook .xlsx (MFA)

routes.purpose: Download the current catalogue (products, price tiers, categories, how-to sheet).

routes.name: Preview a product workbook upload (MFA, saves workbook_token)

routes.purpose: Body: the .xlsx file.

routes.name: Import the ERP stock list (dry run first)

routes.name: Link an ERP item to its website product

routes.name: What the AI may say about a product's packings

routes.name: Material rate proposals (saves rate_id)
routes.purpose: Material price proposals (from the v2 scraper or staff) waiting for the manager's decision.

routes.name: Approve a rate proposal (MFA)

routes.purpose: Manager (MFA): accept a proposed material rate (may be corrected); it becomes the current rate.

routes.name: Reject a rate proposal (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)
routes.purpose: Manager (MFA): reject a proposed material rate.

routes.name: How fresh the material rates are
routes.purpose: How old each material's approved rate is (stale rates block pricing).

routes.name: List business settings
routes.purpose: §20.11 business settings (timers, follow-up days, VAT, Incoterm, validity, hours, opt-out rules ...).

routes.name: Change a business setting (MFA)

routes.purpose: Manager / admin (MFA): change one business setting (validated; logged).

routes.name: Switch a feature flag (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)

routes.name: Set away / backup colleague

routes.name: Dashboard summary (manager / MD)
routes.purpose: Compact pipeline summary: deals by stage, open pipeline value, approvals pending / overdue, open tasks.

routes.name: Company details for quotes

routes.name: Edit company details (MFA)

routes.name: Remove the quote logo (MFA)
routes.who: manager, md, admin + signed in with the authenticator app (mfa=true)

routes.name: Kill switch - read level

routes.name: Kill switch - set level (MFA)

routes.name: Search contacts (by buyer_phone; saves contact_id)
routes.purpose: Search by name, email or phone digits.

routes.name: Get contact
routes.purpose: §20.6 one contact (a salesperson only for contacts of their own deals).

routes.name: Edit contact

routes.name: List buyer companies

routes.name: Create a buyer company (saves company_id)

routes.name: Edit a buyer company

routes.name: List products (saves product_id)

routes.name: Get product

routes.name: Edit product (MFA)

routes.name: List orders (saves order_id)
routes.purpose: §20.9 orders (a salesperson: their own deals), newest first.

routes.name: Currency rates to AED
routes.purpose: The latest rate per currency (the one quotes use).

routes.purpose: D38 "the manager can override": a manual rate for a day (it replaces that day's rate).

routes.name: Salesperson dashboard

routes.name: Manager dashboard

routes.name: MD dashboard

routes.purpose: §20.12: a list as CSV or XLSX (a salesperson exports only their own deals and orders; Admin / IT only the product list, L4: §3 gives it users, settings and the catalogue, not customer data).

routes.name: Translate missing texts (MFA)
